body: A vector database and search engine for large-scale similarity search.
plain_description: **Find and organize information by meaning to power smarter search and recommendations.** Store vector data, filter results, and connect Qdrant to your applications. Run it locally or use the managed cloud service.
technical_description: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine and database for storing, searching, and managing vectors with payloads. It supports dense, sparse, and multivector search; filtering, hybrid search, recommendations, and vector quantization. It offers REST and gRPC APIs, a Web UI, distributed deployment, a managed cloud service, and Qdrant Edge for local, offline-capable use.
title: Qdrant
